fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-08-12 (night, 00:35): A caller repeatedly demanded Rs. 50,000 from the complainant and threatened to visit the premises. Rajesh Rajan approached Erode Central PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000302. The complaint refers to Udhay Muthu, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000352. A person named Prakash Muthu, associated with the number 9000000312, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Abirami Sekar (9000000186) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly demanded money with threats of consequences.
